steps.content:
The day before
September 29, 9:30 PM
MBCC - Chief's Office

steps.speaker: Telephone
steps.content: I don't care what **** boss of Noms you are! Now listen up! The Sleepwalkers case is mine! Don't stick your ******* nose into this!
With the sound of something smashing to the ground, the call cuts off.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Maybe it's not the best time for him right now. Don't worry. This contact already promised yesterday to meet you at the mission location.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Background check confirmed. His name is <color=#fb9259>Doyle</color>. He used to be a renowned inspector in Eastside, and an informant for the 9th Agency. An upright and hardworking man. Though he has temporarily left his post due to some <color=#fb9259>personal issues</color>, he is still quite reliable when he is sober.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: He will assist us in this operation.
Operation... You pick up the letter from the table and tear open the ever-pompous sealing wax.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Hello, Chief ${PlayerName}. Regarding the rumors about the Sleepwalkers in Eastside's District 14, your trusty adjutant will surely tell you about them in detail.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Rumors are spreading like wildfire. Some say that Sinners created this crisis, while others claim that Mania broke through the West District's quarantine measures after the crisis at the Square.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: In any case, Eastside residents now feel that they're under threat, and the City Council is highly concerned as a result. They want you to investigate the matter. Of course, if it can be completely resolved, it's a happy ending for everyone.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Commander <color=#fb9259>Langley</color> has approved. She said that a talented individual like you can easily resolve such a trivial matter.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: So, we have to rely on you once again.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: At the moment, there is no evidence implicating Sinners in these incidents. Preliminary investigations can be carried out by the Bureau's city arrest team. You are still on vacation, so you don't need to go in person now.
You can indeed skip out on this operation, but there is something unusual about this case.
Ordinary Sinner cases don't grab the attention of that "superior," let alone requests from the City Council. You know Langley doesn't care about those.
This assignment is either an annoying test, or... There's something behind it she's interested in. You see this as a great opportunity to "get to know" your elusive new superior.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. I will prepare a simple disguise for you immediately. The place you will be going to is...

September 30, 7:00 PM
Eastside District 14 - Midsummer Night's Club

This new upscale club is the talk of the town. Funded by Quinn, it aims to recreate a romantic midsummer night in the desert city... and now, it's hosting a cocktail party for the upcoming opening ceremony.

Clad in an expensive suit prepared by Nightingale and clutching the invitation letter from the 9th Agency in hand, you mingle among the glamorous socialites of Eastside and slip into the club to look for your contact.
steps.female_content: Clad in an expensive gown prepared by Nightingale and clutching the invitation letter from the 9th Agency in hand, you mingle among the glamorous socialites of Eastside and slip into the club to look for your contact.

steps.content: You feel a bit out of place. You're more used to the chaos of Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft, you look like a dummy! Your hands and feet are all out of place! Not used to wearing anything other than that ragged MBCC cloak, eh? Hahaha... Hey Hecate! Why are you poking me again?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Please don't worry, Chief. Your disguise is excellent. Your manners are impeccable, and those clothes are a perfect fit for you. Everything is perfect for this undercover operation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Eastside residents are very sensitive to matters pertaining to Sinners, and the MBCC is also a highly confidential bureau. Concealing your identity is the optimal strategy, but you don't need to be too nervous.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Eastside isn't like the West District. There are no riots nor Mania outbreaks. Most of the time, it's quite safe here.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Sinners are on standby nearby, and I'm also monitoring the situation from the MBCC. No matter what happens, you'll have backup to help you.
You look around, but fail to find the "Inspector." But since the 9th Agency chose the Midsummer Night's Club as the meeting location, it must be of value for other intelligence.
The club staff members weave through the crowds, serving drinks to the guests. You pick up a glass and swirl it slowly, mingling into the glamorous crowd.

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: ...You saw it?

steps.speaker: Nervous Male Voice
steps.content: ...Oh, yes. I saw a Sleepwalker spit out a pile of black goo with my own eyes. Do you think it was a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Calm Female Voice
steps.content: Impossible. There's no Mania in Eastside. Don't the infected get whisked away to the West District as soon as they're discovered? We've been fine for so many years, and things will surely remain fine...

steps.speaker: Nervous Male Voice
steps.content: I heard that back in August, there was another major Mania outbreak in West District... The FAC said they resolved it, but who knows? A depraved place like Syndicate...
You hear Hella's curses from your earpiece. You quietly lower the volume.

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: ...Don't worry. Isn't the quarantine belt by the Rust just fine? The Sleepwalkers are probably just a rumor made up by internet trolls to gain traffic. If something really happens in Eastside, the whole world will probably come to an end.

steps.speaker: Elegant Male Voice
steps.content: Enjoy the party. This is Quinn's latest investment. The venue is top-class. Maybe we'll get to see some <color=#fb9259>Ambrosia</color>!
As you listen intently, a light sound chimes from the glass in your hand.
A strange, gaudily dressed woman has slipped next to you without you noticing. The drink in her hand seems quite special.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Hey mister, you look a bit bored. Does this place bore you?
steps.female_content: Hey miss, you look a bit bored. Does this place bore you?

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Or maybe... you're trying to find out something?

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Have you been waiting for a long time? Want to watch something entertaining to kill the time?

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: I'm great at entertaining people. That's why I was invited here.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: A performer. The boss of this place invited me here to create joy for everyone. I'm very good at it.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: The show is about to start. Want to come watch?
She smiles and raises her glass to you.

But just as you raise your glass and step closer, the liquid inside suddenly ignites. A blue flame surges out from the glass and rushes towards you. The sweet aroma makes you dizzy, and the stunned crowd gasps in amazement.
All of a sudden, the flame dissolves into transparent, bluish-violet bubbles, which scatter and disappear. After a brief silence, the hall bursts into applause.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: A magic show? How spectacular! This Midsummer Night's Club is truly a Quinn masterpiece!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Encore! <size=40>Encore</size>!!

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Just a little trick from the circus. Hope everyone was entertained! Thank you all...
Giggling, she bows to the people around her. She seems quite satisfied with her performance.
You became a prop for her performance, exposed to the public eye. The glass in your hand is still smoldering slightly.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: And thank you, my dear friend! You're such a natural.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: This glass is on me. Dreamy Ambrosia, a special token of my thanks.
You see that the smoke has dissipated from your glass. The liquid inside has changed color, glimmering radiantly with a hint of sweetness.
Amidst the bright colors is the faintly swirling shadow of a snake.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: A toast to you, my dear guest. May you have sweet, happy dreams tonight.

You swirl the glass and take a sip. The taste is sweet, but otherwise unremarkable. Your "undercover" assignment has been interrupted, but the woman is still looking at you and smiling without a hint of concern.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, but it's a bit too sweet for my liking.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss, please find someone else to help you with your performance.
You raise your glass to her. As she prepares to clink glasses with you, you pour the Ambrosia back into her glass.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please tell your boss that not all guests enjoy taking part in these attention-seeking gimmicks.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Are you unhappy? Hmm... my apologies. I didn't prepare well enough for this rehearsal. But how can I hold back when I see someone so adorable?

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: When the real show starts, I'll make it up to you properly.
She giggles, looks you up and down, and then disappears into the crowd.
A man dressed like a butler emerges from the direction she went and bows to you.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Good evening, Chief of Minos. Our apologies for putting you on the spot just now. Our performer just wanted to entertain you. Please don't be offended.
He smiles faintly.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Miss Eirene is thrilled that you're here. However, she's a bit caught up at the moment.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: She hopes you can wait for a bit. Miss Eirene would like to see you.

<color=#fb9259>Eirene</color> is a rising star in Eastside's business world, the President of Quinn, and the owner of Midsummer Night's Club. Due to rumors of her connections with the Outlands, the authorities are very vigilant against her, and she is probably on one of the 9th Agency's lists.
It seems you've been keeping tabs on each other... But unfortunately, you have another assignment tonight.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I will find another chance to visit her.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Then we look forward to seeing you at the official opening ceremony of Midsummer Night's Club.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Excuse me. Is the district inspector here? His name is Doyle.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: This gentleman's name was indeed on the invitation list, but he is currently not present. I will keep you informed if Inspector Doyle comes.
Did something happen? You thank the butler, and turn to leave the party.

steps.speaker: Butler
steps.content: Good night, sir. You're always welcome at the Midsummer Night's Club.
steps.female_content: Good night, ma'am. You're always welcome at the Midsummer Night's Club.

steps.content: After leaving through the back door of the club, you open your comms, and walk towards the alley leading to the contact point.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You didn't see Inspector Doyle? How strange... The District 14 Public Security Bureau said his coordinates are near the club. Did something happen...
Blegh... blegh...

The slurred sound of vomiting can be heard from a nearby garbage heap. Several people, with their heads buried in garbage bags, are vomiting and mumbling incessantly. You can't tell what smells worse, the garbage or the people.
You hear a familiar voice among them.

steps.speaker: Drunk Middle-aged Man
steps.content: Sleep... Sleepwalk... Club...

steps.speaker: Drunk Middle-aged Man
steps.content: What Noms... It's my case, assist your ***...
You pick up the Eastside public security ID on the ground. Logistics staff, Doyle...
He looks kind nice in his ID photo.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...Why are you touching my stuff? Who the **** are you?!
The man suddenly gets up and shoves you against the brick wall. The vomit on his hand splatters on the clothes Nightingale picked out for you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: There's a bit of issue here.

steps.content: The delirious inspector tries to say something to you, but the "friend" at his feet is already pinching his ankles.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: What happened... How did you guys end up like this? What did you eat last night? Your vomit is disgusting...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ! You are...?

The inspector suddenly regains his clarity. He lunges at you, knocking you out of the Sleepwalkers' attack range. At the same time, the sleepwalking man stoops over and spews a large pile of black goo from his mouth...

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Sleepwalker?!
The black goo splashed on the ground seems to be alive. After a few quick wriggles, it morphed into a new human shape. This certainly matches the description of the "sleepwalker" report.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Why are you standing there?! Come behind me if you want to live!
The Inspector stands in front of you, eyes blazing, and grabs something off the ground to aim at the enemy and shoots. On closer inspection, it's only a crappy leather shoe in his hand.
The inspector fires his "pistol" with a shout. The body of the black goo monster forms a big hole. You are shocked. Is this Sinner power?

steps.speaker: Doyle and Hecate
steps.content:
Die!
Chief!
As Doyle roars energetically, the Nightmare arrives...
